links.outcome: Palliative care consultation rate and readmissions with AI tool versus usual care in stepped-wedge trial
links.effect: Intervention had higher palliative care consultation incidence (IRR 1.44, 95% CI 1.11-1.92). Exploratory 60-day and 90-day readmissions were lower (OR 0.75 and 0.72).
links.quote: Patients randomized to the intervention had a statistically significant higher incidence rate of palliative care consultation compared to the control group (IRR, 1.44 [95% CI, 1.11-1.92]).

screen.reason: This is a pragmatic cluster-randomized trial evaluating the clinical effectiveness of deploying an AI/ML clinical decision support tool for palliative care referral versus usual care, rather than comparing specific guardrails or deployment practices.
